regularGames: All completed gameType=2 records with gameStateId 6 or 7. Never filter COVID seasons or normalize away real games.
playoffGames: Completed gameType=3 rounds 1–4 only; exactly 870 games matched to the previously bracket-verified 150 best-of-seven series. 44 games from 2020 preliminary qualifiers/round robin omitted.
identifiers: Stringified official NHL team IDs, exact match to canonical LeagueLab NHL standings. season is ending year integer; source season 20232024 maps to 2024.
decision: For regular season period 3 = REG, 4 = OT, 5 = SO. In playoffs every period > 3 is OT, never SO. Decisions validated against all 312 official team-season regulation/shootout/ROW counts.
standingsPoints: Winner 2; regulation loser 0; OT/SO loser 1, except official goalie-pull point-forfeiture exception. Playoff points and standingsResult are null because playoffs do not award standings points.
lossMeaning: Official NHL losses means zero-point losses, not strictly regulation losses. The 2024 Minnesota exception is an OT game classified L rather than OTL.
scores: homeScore/awayScore preserve official final score, which awards the shootout winner one artificial goal. homeGoals/awayGoals remove only that shootout marker; sums exactly reproduce every official team goalsFor/goalsAgainst total. Actual OT goals are retained.
neutrality: Official API schedule neutralSite is present for all 13,070 retained games, including 48 neutral-site regular-season games. All 86 games in the 2020 Stanley Cup main playoff bracket are explicitly treated as neutral bubble games. Outdoor and international games follow the official schedule flag; no regular game is assumed non-neutral by default.
sources: Cached unmodified official NHL API responses, exact URLs and SHA256 values in nhl-game-sources.json. No external writes or canonical file edits.
validation: 312 team-seasons × 10 official standings fields matched exactly; all 12,200 regular games retained; duplicate IDs prohibited; games/teams/scores reconciled.
covid: 2019-20 and2020-21 retained; model weighting or exclusions are downstream choices. 2020 playoff bubble override must not leak to 2019-20 regular games.

exception.reason: Minnesota pulled its goalie and conceded an empty-net overtime goal; official standings record a loss without the overtime point.
